segments.comment: Variation of mention-map-light-source-warning-notice with MSGTYPE=hide for the warning glyph's notice. pline.c vpline() (245-264) drops a hidden line before it reaches the vision recalculation at 266-272, so makemon.c makemon()'s canseemon() test (1479) still reads the dark square and prints no 'appears' message. The recalculation waits for the end of the command, and only '(2north): a +0 ya.' is printed.
